colorSystem.title: Color System
colorSystem.description: Color scales, semantic tokens, and utilities. Install without components.

foundation.title: Foundation
foundation.description: Kit CSS entry, component styles, hooks, and cn. Depends on color-system. Install first for components.

components.name: accordion
components.title: Accordion
components.description: Expandable sections with single or multiple open items.

components.name: avatar
components.title: Avatar
components.description: Person mark with photo or initials, optional presence, and a stacked overflow group.

components.name: badge
components.title: Badge
components.description: Compact labels for status, counts, and metadata.

components.name: border-glow
components.title: Border Glow
components.description: Pointer directed border glow wrapper with optional soft bloom.

components.name: button
components.title: Button
components.description: Primary actions with variants, text sizes, icon sizes, and a plain icon-only style.

components.name: chart
components.title: Chart
components.description: Chart frame with optional title, description, toolbar, loading and empty states, plus legend and tooltip helpers.

components.name: checkbox
components.title: Checkbox
components.description: Native checkbox with optional label and description, including indeterminate.

components.name: choice-chip
components.title: Choice Chip
components.description: Compact selectable chip for filters. Host owns grouping and multi-select.

components.name: color-picker
components.title: Color Picker
components.description: Swatch trigger with hex trailing, hover border, and channel editors.

components.name: combobox
components.title: Combobox
components.description: Filterable text field with an option list, optional async loading, and custom values.

components.name: command-palette
components.title: Command Palette
components.description: Searchable command dialog with ranking, optional async source, and recent ids.

components.name: content-switcher
components.title: Content Switcher
components.description: Segmented single select for filters and view modes. Does not own tab panels.

components.name: contents-nav
components.title: Contents Nav
components.description: Page outline and catalogue index composed with List Item. Use toc for on-page headings with optional nest line and scroll spy. Use index for sectioned side navigation.

components.name: context-menu
components.title: Context Menu
components.description: Pointer and keyboard menu with nested submenus and an imperative open helper.

components.name: data-grid
components.title: Data Grid
components.description: Virtualized table with resizable columns, selection, and optional cell editing.

components.name: date-picker
components.title: Date Picker
components.description: Single day and range calendars in a popover, with locale-aware month titles and week start.

components.name: dialog
components.title: Dialog
components.description: Center modal with scrim, focus trap, Escape to close, and scroll lock.

components.name: dock-panel
components.title: Dock Panel
components.description: Collapsible edge-docked inspector with a kit scrollbar body. Prefer this for persistent side chrome; prefer Options Panel for anchored temporary controls.

components.name: drawer
components.title: Drawer
components.description: Edge modal sheet with scrim, focus trap, and Escape to close.

components.name: dropdown-menu
components.title: Dropdown Menu
components.description: Anchored action menu with header, body, and footer. Rows compose List Item. Prefer Option List for pickers that keep a selected value.

components.name: editor
components.title: Editor
components.description: Markdown-backed rich text surface with optional static and floating format toolbars.

components.name: empty-state
components.title: Empty State
components.description: Placeholder for missing or filtered results with glyph, title, description, and optional action.

components.name: featured-icon
components.title: Featured Icon
components.description: Static featured icon shell with chrome variants, semantic colors, sizes, shape, and a plain glyph mode.

components.name: file-uploader
components.title: File Uploader
components.description: Click, drag, or paste target for files with consumer-owned validation. Defaults to images. Use the tile variant for compact square or circle add and replace controls such as profile photos.

components.name: floating-controls
components.title: Floating Controls
components.description: Modular action strip for canvas toolbars and docks.

components.name: format-toolbar
components.title: Format Toolbar
components.description: Rich text formatting toolbar with headings, marks, lists, callouts, and table row and column actions.

components.name: input
components.title: Input
components.description: Text fields with variants, sizes, labels, icons, clear control, numeric stepper, change or blur value commit, addons, input groups, hover and focus borders, and validation.

components.name: kbd
components.title: Kbd
components.description: Keyboard hint chip for shortcuts and key chords.

components.name: label
components.title: Label
components.description: Field and section labels with leading and trailing slots, required and optional marks, subtext, control inset alignment, and typography chrome.

components.name: list-item
components.title: List Item
components.description: Configurable row with leading, secondary, trailing, density, muted or accent variants, readOnly presentational rows, and as="button" or asChild link hosts. Includes ListItemLabel for menu and nav section headings, and ListItemNest for indented child groups with an optional guide line. Option List, Select, Combobox, Tag Input, Contents Nav, Sidebar, and Dropdown Menu compose these for selectable options, outlines, and app nav.

components.name: number-slider
components.title: Number Slider
components.description: Compact labeled Slider convenience with a live numeric readout. Prefer Slider for dual thumb, marks, orientation, or richer value chrome.

components.name: option-list
components.title: Option List
components.description: Picker panel with option rows, search, checks, and footer actions. Rows compose List Item. Configure root width and panel match. Select composes this.

components.name: options-panel
components.title: Options Panel
components.description: Anchored popover shell with header, body, and footer slots for custom controls. Footer owns gapX and gapY, with FooterActions and FooterMeta for paired actions and status copy. Prefer this over Popover when the surface needs composed controls.

components.name: overlay-hint
components.title: Overlay Hint
components.description: On-canvas instruction or status pill with frosted, muted, and marquee variants.

components.name: panel-section
components.title: Panel Section
components.description: Titled groupings for control panels and inspectors.

components.name: popover
components.title: Popover
components.description: Anchored panel for mid-range tasks such as share sheets and short forms. Prefer Options Panel for denser inspectors, and Tooltip for hover-only hints.

components.name: progress
components.title: Progress
components.description: Linear progress bar for determinate or indeterminate completion.

components.name: radio-group
components.title: Radio Group
components.description: Exclusive native radio group with optional heading and per-item labels.

components.name: scroll-area
components.title: Scroll Area
components.description: Scrollable regions with a custom thumb.

components.name: search-input
components.title: Search Input
components.description: Search field with clear control, icon placement, background fill, and hover border.

components.name: select
components.title: Select
components.description: Single or multi choice field that composes Option List. Rows use List Item chrome. Configure width and open-list sizing. Closed list selection, not free-text autocomplete.

components.name: separator
components.title: Separator
components.description: Horizontal or vertical rules between sections.

components.name: sidebar
components.title: Sidebar
components.description: Composable primary navigation with provider state, collapse modes, and a List Item menu hierarchy.

components.name: skeleton
components.title: Skeleton
components.description: Decorative loading placeholder shapes. Always aria-hidden; announce busy state on the host.

components.name: slider
components.title: Slider
components.description: Single or dual thumb scrubber with marks, orientation, label, and value chrome. Prefer Number Slider for a compact settings row, and Tick Slider for bound labels with a tick gauge.

components.name: spectrum-text
components.title: Spectrum Text
components.description: Inline text with a shifting multi stop gradient fill.

components.name: spinner
components.title: Spinner
components.description: Indeterminate circular loading indicator.

components.name: split
components.title: Split
components.description: Two-pane layout with a keyboard and pointer resizable separator.

components.name: status-dot
components.title: Status Dot
components.description: Filled presence mark for online, live, and similar status chips.

components.name: switch
components.title: Switch
components.description: Binary on and off control for immediate settings.

components.name: tabs
components.title: Tabs
components.description: Panel switcher with pill, line, and segment variants. Prefer Content Switcher when you only switch mode without tab panels.

components.name: tag-input
components.title: Tag Input
components.description: Chip field for a string[] value with suggestions, paste batching, and max tags.

components.name: text-mark
components.title: Text Mark
components.description: Hand drawn text marks: highlight wash, underline, circle, and related annotation kinds.

components.name: tick-slider
components.title: Tick Slider
components.description: Bound labels, tick gauge, optional purpose title, and floating value bubble.

components.name: timeline
components.title: Timeline
components.description: Virtualized timeline with time-scale bars, dependency paths, and snapped drag edits.

components.name: toast
components.title: Toast
components.description: Transient messages with tone, a leading slot, and screen position.

components.name: toggle-group
components.title: Toggle Group
components.description: Grouped toggle buttons with a clearable string[] selection model. Prefer Content Switcher for exclusive view modes as segments.

components.name: nav-rail
components.title: Tool Rail
components.description: Fixed icon-over-label edge rail for switching tools or modes.

components.name: tooltip
components.title: Tooltip
components.description: Compact and detailed labels on hover, focus, or a viewport point.

components.name: widget-grid
components.title: Widget Grid
components.description: Draggable and resizable widget layout on a CSS grid with keyboard edit affordances.
